title: SREV-063 GUI SetWindowLong stub parser contract

set_window_long_a_stub.description: SetWindowLongA or SetWindowLongPtrA exported entry bytes accepted by the local parser

set_window_long_w_stub.description: SetWindowLongW or SetWindowLongPtrW exported entry bytes accepted by the local parser

worker_target.description: Shared worker address derived only after required stubs are schema-valid

contracts: SetWindowLongA/W and SetWindowLongPtrA/W are User32 exported APIs, but their entry byte layout is not a Win32 API contract
The local A-side parser accepts only 41 B9 01 00 00 00 E9 followed by rel32
The local W-side parser accepts only 45 33 C9 E9 followed by rel32
The A-side branch displacement may be read only after the full A-side prefix and E9 opcode are proven
The SetWindowLong8 and SetWindowLongPtr8 hooks may be installed only after schema-valid target derivation
